title: Holistic Approach to Measure Sample-level Adversarial Vulnerability and its Utility in Building Trustworthy Systems
reasoning: The paper's central motivation and contribution is the development of 'trustworthy systems' by addressing 'robustness bias.' This bias is explicitly framed as a fairness and ethical issue, where certain subgroups (e.g., based on gender or race) are disproportionately harmed by adversarial attacks. The concept of fairness is integral to the proposed methodology, not just a peripheral discussion.
